csv_project_name: AE for As-Needed MPEA Professional Services
csv_scope_of_work: The Metropolitan Pier and Exposition Authority (MPEA) seeks to retain firms to provide various professional Services on an as needed, Task Order, basis for all MPEA facilities. Consultants will perform, manage, and coordinate the required project scope of services. The requirements for services will vary according to the specific needs of each project. Design Services may be required in any type of MPEA facility including the Exhibit Halls, the hotels, the arena, the corporate offices, garages, surface parking areas, the physical plant or any of the adjacent outdoor areas.
